scheme_name: Welfare Measures for Children of Labourers
other_conditions: Children of SC/ST labourers working in coffee plantations or licensed coffee curing works are eligible.
Eligibility is limited to the first two surviving children of such labourers; twins or multiple births are all eligible if they meet individual merit requirements.
Children of clerks, drivers, supervisors, and estate/curing works managers are excluded.
Applicants must be pursuing higher education after completing the 10th grade.
The educational institution must be recognized by the Central or State Government.
Students must have passed SSLC/10th and be enrolled in 1st‑year PUC, Polytechnic, vocational training, graduation, post‑graduation or professional courses.
One male and one female student per region who achieved the highest marks in the SSLC/10th examination are eligible for the incentive award.
benefits_summary: Educational stipend of ₹2,250 per student, incentive awards of ₹1,000 (boys) or ₹1,500 (girls) in addition to the stipend, and financial assistance up to ₹7,500 for higher‑education courses.
